name: Wildflower
character: Variable, floral-fruity; a forgiving all-rounder for melomels and metheglins.

name: Clover
character: Mild, clean and sweet; lets fruit and spice lead. Can taste neutral in traditionals.

name: Orange Blossom
character: Delicate citrus-floral aromatics; easily masked — keep spice at or below the subtle dose.

name: Tupelo
character: Buttery, floral, high fructose; elegant in traditionals and sacks.

name: Acacia (Black Locust)
character: Very light, vanilla-floral; a showcase for delicate fruit (pear, white peach).

name: Meadowfoam
character: Marshmallow-vanilla; pairs with dessert profiles and stone fruit.

name: Buckwheat
character: Dark, malty, molasses and barnyard; demands dark fruit (cherry, blackberry), baking spice and long ageing.

name: Avocado
character: Dark, caramel-molasses; great in sacks and with coffee or cacao.

name: Heather (Ling)
character: Thixotropic, high moisture; bitter-floral and smoky. Stands up to strong spice.
